dataset.name: Amazon US FBA Fee Rates 2027
dataset.description: Amazon US Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) fee schedule announced 2026-11-05, effective 2027-01-15. Separate file from fba-us-2026.json ON PURPOSE: the 2027 card re-prices by BOTH weight rung and price band ($10/$50 cut-offs), restructures bulky into 4 tiers and oversized into 6 tiers, and narrows Low-Price FBA eligibility. The 2026 file is a flat base_fee per tier and must NOT be mutated to hold this shape.

effective_dates.note: 2027-01-15 is both the last day of the 2026-27 peak window and the first day of this card - every caller must pass a ship date.

dataset.verified_by: Browser-rendered scrape of the official help page (the page is JS-rendered; curl returns a 171 KB shell with no rates). Every number in rates.fulfillment_fees_standard and rates.fulfillment_fees_standard_apparel was compared cell-by-cell against the page: 21/21 standard rows x 3 price bands x 2 cards, zero mismatches.

low_price_fba_eligibility.rule: From 2027-01-15 a <$10 item in an EXCLUDED fee category loses the Low-Price FBA rate and is billed at the $10-$50 rate instead.
excluded_categories_official: 汽车和户外动力设备 (Automotive & Power Sports)
乐器和影音制作 (Musical Instruments & AV Production)
媒介类商品 - 图书、DVD、音乐、软件和视频 (Media - Books, DVD, Music, Software, Video)
low_price_fba_eligibility.mapper_note: ylishi maps 4 of the 5 to CATEGORIES keys (automotive / musical / books / software). Small Appliances and Computers have no key in the 2026 category list — those two are NOT enforceable until a category exists.

changes_vs_2026.bulky_restructure: 2026 had 2 bulky tiers (Small/Large Bulky). 2027 splits them into 4: 小号大件 / 中号大件 / 大号大件 / 超大号大件.
changes_vs_2026.oversized_restructure: 2026 had 4 oversized tiers. 2027 splits them into 6: 小型超大件 / 中型超大件 / 大型超大件 / 长型超大件 / 轻型特殊超大件 / 重型特殊超大件.
changes_vs_2026.handling_fee_change: From 2027-01-15 the extra-large handling fee (2026: $17/$21/$25 by weight band) is RETIRED. Replaced by two dimension-based fees that can stack: flat-item handling ($8.40-$29.53) when shortest side <4in AND second-longest >=25in, and protruding-item handling ($3.45-$10.45) when second-longest >43in. A single item can now pay both.
changes_vs_2026.low_inventory_fee: From 2027-02-01 charged only when stock is below 28 days of supply, measured on actual shipments in the 4 weeks BEFORE and AFTER the assessment date (was: 30-day and 90-day historical sales). Year confirmed as 2027 by three independent official pages (overview page, 2027 fulfilment page, unified-storage page). The forward 4-week window is unknowable at quote time - a calculator must say it cannot evaluate it.
changes_vs_2026.unified_storage: From 2027-02-01 the storage-utilisation surcharge is retired and the aged-inventory surcharge folds into a single age-banded monthly storage rate. Full table now in rates.unified_monthly_storage_2027. <6 months flat or lower, >6 months rises; apparel 181-270 days pays a lower rate (1.78/1.56) but is now charged at all (was exempt).
changes_vs_2026.size_tier_definitions: From 2027-01-15: bulky 2 -> 4 tiers (28/24/20, 37/28/20, 52/28/28, 59/33/33) and oversized 4 -> 6 tiers keyed on longest side (72, 78, 96, 108, >=108+>=165, >150 lb). Never map 2026 tiers to 2027 by name - re-tier on billable weight.
changes_vs_2026.billable_weight: Dimensional weight = L x W x H / 139; bulky and oversized assume a minimum width and height of 2 inches. Overage rounds up to the whole pound. Prices of exactly $10 or $50 take the $10-$50 band. Peak is decided by ship date.
changes_vs_2026.inbound_placement: Rate card unchanged; from 2027-01-15 standard-size Central placement merges into East (regions 3 -> 2). See rates.inbound_placement_current for the real published ranges.

mcf_and_buy_with_prime.note: MCF size tiers align with FBA; boxed returns get a return surcharge

billable_weight_rule.official_text_zh: 体积重量等于单件商品体积（长 x 宽 x 高）除以 139。对于大件商品和超大件商品，我们假定最小宽度和高度为 2 英寸。对于所有大号标准尺寸、大件和超大件商品（特殊超大件重型商品除外），如果体积重量大于单件商品重量，我们将按体积重量计算费用。小号标准尺寸和特殊超大件重型商品将按单件商品重量计算费用。
billable_weight_rule.dim_weight_formula: 长(in) x 宽(in) x 高(in) / 139, result in lb
exceptions_billed_on_unit_weight_only: Special Oversize Heavy (重型特殊超大件)
billable_weight_rule.why_it_matters: A calculator that asks only for "shipping weight" under-quotes every Large Standard / bulky / oversized item whenever the carton is light and bulky. The three official worked examples all use dimensional weight, not unit weight, as the billable figure.

fulfillment_fees_bulky_oversized_dangero.label_note: The official dangerous-goods table repeats 小号大件/中号大件/大号大件 for rows 5-7. Mapped to 小型超大件/中型超大件/大型超大件 by price level and by matching the non-hazardous table structure. This is our mapping, not the official label.

The official dangerous-goods table repeats 小号大件/中号大件/大号大件 for rows 5-7. Mapped to 小型超大件/中型超大件/大型超大件 by price level and by matching the non-hazardous table structure. This is our mapping, not the official label.

The official dangerous-goods table repeats 小号大件/中号大件/大号大件 for rows 5-7. Mapped to 小型超大件/中型超大件/大型超大件 by price level and by matching the non-hazardous table structure. This is our mapping, not the official label.

dangerous_goods_note.official_text_zh: 对于需要进行特殊处理和储存的危险品，亚马逊物流会收取单独的配送费用。
dangerous_goods_note.why_it_matters: Dangerous goods (batteries, aerosols, flammables, magnets, etc.) are NOT charged the standard bulky/oversized rate. The surcharge is material: 小号大件 8.24 vs 7.51 (+0.73) and 重型特殊超大件 216.23 vs 191.28 (+24.95). Any calc that ignores the DG table under-quotes DG sellers, most on the heavy tiers.
dangerous_goods_note.coverage_gap: 2026 non-peak and 2026 peak DG tables are now captured (see fulfillment_fees_bulky_oversized_dangerous_goods_2026).
dangerous_goods_note.hazmat_classification: Amazon decides DG status per ASIN; this dataset does not classify products.

oversized_handling_fees_2027.official_intro_zh: 自 2027 年 1 月 15 日起，具有特定包装属性的超大件商品将根据其尺寸，在亚马逊物流配送费用之外收取扁平商品处理费、超限悬挂处理费或这两项费用。

charge_triggers.fee: 扁平商品处理费 (flat-item handling fee)
charge_triggers.condition: 最短边 < 4 英寸 且 次长边 >= 25 英寸
charge_triggers.condition_en: shortest side < 4 in AND second-longest side >= 25 in

charge_triggers.fee: 超限悬挂处理费 (protruding-item handling fee)

charge_triggers.condition: 同时满足以上两个条件

oversized_handling_fees_2027.note_no_charge_tiers: 小型/中型/大型超大件只可能收扁平费，不收超限悬挂费（官方只给长型、轻型特殊、重型特殊三档悬挂费）。
oversized_handling_fees_2027.billable_weight_note: 重型特殊超大件按商品重量，其余按商品重量与体积重量二者中的较大值。

oversized_handling_fees_2026.official_rule_zh: 最长边超过 96 英寸或者长度加围长超过 130 英寸的超大件（不超过 150 磅）商品将被视为特大号商品。
oversized_handling_fees_2026.retired: 自 2027-01-15 起取消特大号处理费，改按新的大件尺寸分段与扁平/悬挂处理费收取。

fulfillment_fees_bulky_oversized_dangero.note: 2026 uses the OLD tier structure: 2 bulky (小号/大号大件) + 4 oversized. The 2027 card splits these into 4 bulky + 6 oversized, so tier_key here is NOT comparable to the 2027 keys — xl_0_50 / xl_50_70 / xl_70_150 / xl_150_plus are 2026-only identifiers.
fulfillment_fees_bulky_oversized_dangero.billable_weight_note: 超大件 150 磅以上按商品重量；其余取商品重量与体积重量中的较大值。
fulfillment_fees_bulky_oversized_dangero.extra_large_handling_note: 2026 危险品同样适用特大号处理费 $17/$21/$25（最长边>96 英寸或长+围长>130 英寸），适用至 2027-01-14。

size_tier_classification.official_text_zh: 亚马逊将商品分为三种尺寸分段：标准尺寸：商品包裹需同时满足以下所有条件：长度（最长边）不超过18英寸、宽度（次长边）不超过14英寸、高度（最短边）不超过8英寸、重量不超过20磅。大件：商品包裹的重量和尺寸超过标准尺寸商品的任何标准，但未达到超大件商品的标准。超大件：商品包裹满足以下任一条件即视为超大件：长度（最长边）为96英寸或更大、长度加围长为130英寸或更大（围长计算方式为2×高+2×宽）、重量为50磅或更重、商品是电视机且长度（最长边）为40英寸或更大。
size_tier_classification.bulky: exceeds at least one standard criterion but hits none of the oversized triggers
size_tier_classification.KNOWN_GAP: This page defines only the THREE top-level classes (standard / bulky / oversized). It does NOT give the cut-offs that split bulky into the 2027 four tiers (小号/中号/大号/超大号大件) or oversized into the 2027 six tiers (小型/中型/大型/长型/轻型特殊/重型特殊超大件). Those cut-offs are NOT in this dataset and must not be guessed — the tier fees themselves ARE official.

delivery_speed_targets.note: Delivery-speed attainment targets per class, from the same page. Separate from fees; recorded because it is part of the published tier definition.

validation_against_official_examples.consistent: NO — the 3-class rule puts it in bulky, yet Amazon prices it on an oversized tier. Proves the bulky->oversized sub-cut-offs come from a different rule set than this page.

size_tier_classification.SUPERSeded_BY: rates.size_tier_definitions_2027 — the detailed 2027 table reproduces all 9 official examples; this 3-class summary does not and must not be used for tier assignment.

size_tier_definitions_2027.billable_weight: 发货重量 = max(商品重量, 体积重量)，体积重量 = 长×宽×高 ÷ 139。小号标准尺寸与重型特殊超大件按商品重量。
size_tier_definitions_2027.how_to_use: 自上而下逐档检查；第一个所有列都满足的档即为该商品的尺寸分段。

tiers_2027.note: 超过 150 磅即为此档，其他条件不设限

tiers_2026.note: 最长边>59 或 次长边>33 或 最短边>33 或 长+围长>130 或 发货重量>50

validated_against_official_examples.item: 桌面面板 70×44×3, 50 lb / 体积重 66.47 lb

size_tier_definitions_2027.validation_result: 9/9 official worked examples reproduced. This table REPLACES the earlier 3-class rule as the operative classifier — the 3-class rule put 墙板 and 显示器 on bulky, contradicting Amazon. See rates.size_tier_classification for the superseded summary.

end_to_end_check.method: Read the published JSON, classify by tiers_2027, price with fulfillment_fees_bulky_oversized + oversized_handling_fees_2027, compare to the official worked examples.
end_to_end_check.result: 6/6 tier classifications correct. 5/6 totals match exactly. The sixth (显示器) differs only because the official FULFILLMENT page lists fulfillment fee alone ($27.10) and omits the $8.40 flat-item handling fee that its own dimension rule triggers (shortest 3.5in <4 AND second-longest 34in >=25) — the official HANDLING page prices the analogous thin board as $24.86+$8.40=$33.26. Our figure of $35.50 is the complete charge, not an error.

known_calculator_gap.issue: js/fba-rates-2026.js stores only 3 Small-Standard rungs (2/4/6 oz). The official Small-Standard card has 8 rungs (2/4/6/8/10/12/14/16 oz).
known_calculator_gap.effect: A genuine Small-Standard item weighing 8-16 oz currently gets quoted from the LARGE-standard ladder and is OVER-quoted: 8oz +$0.41, 10oz +$0.52, 12oz +$0.42, 14oz +$0.69, 16oz +$0.64 (2026 non-peak, $10-50 band). Average $0.54/unit.
known_calculator_gap.why_not_yet_fixed: Small-vs-Large standard is decided by DIMENSIONS (longest<=15in, second<=12in, shortest<=0.75in), not weight. To use the 8 Small-Standard rungs correctly the calculator must classify by dimension first — which classifySize2027 now does. Wiring the 16 oz Small-Standard ladder is the next step; it is stored as SMALL_STANDARD_RUNGS_2027 (reference data) but not yet attached.
known_calculator_gap.reference_array: SMALL_STANDARD_RUNGS_2027 in js/fba-rates-2026.js already holds all 8 rungs with official 2027 values.

calculator_behavior_note.resolved_2026_11_12: 大件分支已按发货日期选表。2027-01-15 之前用 2026 六档（BIG_FEES_2026_NONPEAK/PEAK + DG 两张），之后用 2027 十档。不再出现「2026 日期套 2027 价」的情况。
calculator_behavior_note.card_switch_function: bigFeeForDate(tierKey2027, billableLb, band, shipDate, isDangerous) — 内部按 cardYearFor() 路由，2026 路径还会按 isPeakShipDate() 选旺季表。
calculator_behavior_note.tier_mapping_rule: 2027 十档 -> 2026 六档 不得按名称映射。2027 超大件按最长边拆分、2026 只按重量拆分，故超大件一律用 tier2026ByWeight(billableLb) 重新定档；仅 小号/中号大件->小号大件、大号/超大号大件->大号大件 可直接映射。
calculator_behavior_note.handling_fees: 2027 走尺寸型（扁平 最短边<4 且 次长边>=25；悬挂 次长边>43）。2026 走特大号处理费（最长边>96 或 长+围长>130，且<=150磅，$17/$21/$25）。

peak_fulfillment_2026.important: The uplift is the SAME across all three price bands (<$10 / $10-$50 / >$50) — verified row by row on the official table. Only the base fee varies by band.
peak_fulfillment_2026.avoid: Do NOT apply PEAK_FULFILLMENT.byTier as a flat per-tier uplift. byTier is a per-TIER top-of-range figure (e.g. ss=0.20) but the real uplift steps from 0.19 (<=2oz) to 0.22 (14-16oz) inside ss alone. On ls1 the gap is 0.24 vs 0.29 = up to $0.05/unit.
